themes.title: Mass protests demand Spanish PM’s resignation
themes.blurb: Spain saw tens of thousands march in Madrid demanding Pedro Sánchez’s resignation over corruption scandals, with Vox and PP leaders joining the protests. Similar anti-government demonstrations have emerged in other European countries, reflecting a broader trend of public discontent with ruling parties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Organized and participated in mass protests in Madrid demanding Sánchez’s resignation over corruption scandals like the Plus Ultra case.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 PP
countries.note: Joined Vox in supporting the protests, amplifying calls for Sánchez’s resignation and early elections.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Coverage of protests in Spain as part of broader European discontent with ruling parties, framing it as a cross-national trend.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Highlighted Spain’s protests as part of a broader narrative of political instability and corruption in Europe.

themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are advocating for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, such as restricting access to public services and housing. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, and France, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, and Rassemblement National leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Advocates for 'national priority' policies, including restrictions on migrant access to public services and housing.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports policies that prioritize Italian citizens in public services, aligning with broader far-right narratives.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes policies that prioritize French citizens, such as restricting welfare benefits for immigrants.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration policies and prioritizing Norwegian citizens in public services.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Trump’s policies, including immigration restrictions, AI regulations, and military actions, are heavily influencing right-wing narratives worldwide. His administration’s decisions are frequently cited by right-wing parties in Poland, Argentina, and the UK as models for their own policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump’s policies on immigration, AI, and military actions are central to global right-wing narratives.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Frequently references Trump’s policies as a model for Poland’s approach to security and immigration.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Aligns with Trump’s economic and deregulatory policies, often citing them as inspiration.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for policies similar to Trump’s, particularly on immigration and economic deregulation.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are gaining significant traction in European polls, with parties like AfD in Germany, Sverigedemokraterna in Sweden, and Rassemblement National in France leading in surveys. This trend reflects growing public dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in several German states, reflecting growing far-right support.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Gaining influence in Sweden, pushing for stricter immigration policies and nationalist agendas.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Leads French polls, positioning itself as the dominant far-right force ahead of the 2027 elections.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Increasingly influential in Norway, advocating for stricter immigration controls and nationalist policies.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal divisions, with factions competing for influence and leadership. These conflicts are evident in Poland’s PiS, Hungary’s Fidesz, Argentina’s La Libertad Avanza, and Italy’s Lega.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
